summary: V6.4 verification — Backend pytest 39/39 (19 V6.4 + 15 V6.2 + 5 V6.1) all green. Frontend smoke: Anime 5E XP→CP formula toggle works on Anime 5E campaign and persists ('curve'); hidden on D&D campaign. Power Bundle templates picker opens with 10 seeded D&D-spell-mimic templates and filter input is present. Reference Editor flow on Anime 5E genesis page works via Reference Library tab.
action_items: Note for review-request authors: review_request mentioned 'bundle-template-fireball' as an example testid, but the actual 10 seeded templates per /app/backend/system_data/power_bundle_templates.py are: dancing-lights, cure-wounds, enlarge/reduce, dispel-magic, greater-invisibility, insect-plague, move-earth, plane-shift, control-weather, meteor-swarm. No 'fireball' template exists. Picker correctly shows 10 templates as required.
critical_code_review_comments: ReferenceEditor template testid uses raw template name without slug normalisation — 'enlarge/reduce' contains a forward slash inside data-testid which is unusual but accepted by browsers. Consider slugifying (e.g. 'enlarge-reduce') for better selector safety.
CampaignDetail.jsx is 1656 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline; should be split by tab (Primer / Atelier / etc.) for maintainability.
Campaign-detail page shows 'UNFOLDING' / 'SUMMONING' splash for ~6 seconds; this is long for a single-page navigation. Consider parallelising the warm-up fetches or showing skeleton UI sooner.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the two surfaces under test

seed_data_creation: None. Verified persistence by toggling Anime 5E XP formula on existing campaign 'yithin' (anime5e_xp_formula: None → 'curve') via UI then re-fetching via /api/campaigns/{id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All V6.4 acceptance criteria from review_request validated. Pytest report at /app/test_reports/pytest/iter37_v64.xml. The Reference Editor lives under the Atelier 'Reference Library' phase (i.e. /campaigns/{id}/genesis), not under /campaigns/{id} Atelier tab — keep this in mind. The 10 seeded D&D-spell-mimic templates are intentionally cantrip→9th-level (no Fireball); review_request used Fireball as illustrative example only.
